shots.focal_element: Profound logo lockup on black, then the presenter seated centre-frame at a desk in a dark branded studio set
shots.transition_other: opening shot: fades/blurs up from black (no prior shot)
shots.typography: Logo wordmark: geometric sans, semibold, title case, tight tracking, white on black; set dressing repeats the wordmark on a wall screen ('Profound University') and a 3D desk sign. Font guess (low confidence): Inter-like grotesk.
shots.what_happens: Black frame; the white Profound logo blurs/fades in centre (0.5-1.5s), holds, then the whole logo plate blur-dissolves (around 2.5s) into a warm, low-key wide of the presenter in a studio with practical lamps, wall screen and shelf logo; he opens the VO 'For the past 18 months... the hard way' (w0-w16). In the last sampled frame a frosted card begins to blur in at upper left, leading into s002.
shots.build_rebuild: Fade a centred white wordmark in from blur on black over 1s, hold 1s, then blur-dissolve (filter blur 0->20px with opacity crossfade) into the presenter footage plate.

shots.focal_element: White rounded 'Bot Visits 64.8k' line-chart card floating left of the presenter
shots.typography: Card: small grey sentence-case label over a large bold numeral; clean neo-grotesk sans (low-confidence guess Inter), normal tracking. Desk sign wordmark visible below.
shots.what_happens: Over the same presenter wide, a recreated analytics card with three multi-line series sits in the left third while he says 'profound for visibility and analytics' (w17-w21). The lines draw on left to right across 8.5-10.0s; by 10.5s the card tilts slightly in perspective as it begins to exit/swap.
shots.build_rebuild: Overlay a 375x390px white rounded card (12px radius, soft shadow) at left-third on the presenter plate, blur-in the card, then animate three SVG polyline strokes with stroke-dashoffset over ~1.5s ease-out.

shots.focal_element: Dark 'Let’s create content' prompt card with a typing input field, left of the presenter
on_screen_text: help me write a blog post
shots.typography: Card title: medium-weight sans, sentence case, white on near-black; input text small regular lowercase with caret; chips are small regular sentence-case labels with coloured icons. Low-confidence guess Inter.
shots.what_happens: The card in the same left slot swaps from the white chart to a dark content-generation UI; the prompt 'help me write a blog post' types on character by character with a caret while the VO says 'and a separate tool for content and workflows' (w22-w29). By 13.5s the card has gone and the plain presenter wide remains. The final typed string is read from small contact-sheet frames, so its exact ending is medium confidence.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade the overlay card to a dark variant with a centred title, an input that types 'help me write a blog post' at ~12 chars/s with a blinking caret, and three icon chips below, then fade the card out before the cut.

shots.focal_element: Presenter's face in a tighter medium close-up from a second camera angle, placed left of centre
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a tighter, slightly off-axis camera B on the presenter, with the shelf logo and mic framing the right side, as he says 'Profound has become the de facto platform for understanding' (w30-w38). No overlay. The 17.0s sample already shows the wide angle again, so the actual cut back is probably slightly before the 17.208s boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a second-camera medium close-up of the presenter, framed on the left third with a shallow-focus background, for one VO sentence to reset attention.

shots.focal_element: White 'Citation Share Rank' leaderboard card whose rank and rows reshuffle, left of the presenter
shots.typography: Card: small grey label, very large bold rank numeral with a small red delta arrow, grey column headers, regular-weight row text with tabular percentages and green/red deltas; clean sans (low-confidence guess Inter). On-screen text quoted from the mid-shot keyframe; other states differ.
shots.what_happens: Back on the presenter wide, a frosted card blurs in at the left (around 18.0s) and resolves into a citation-share leaderboard; the headline rank flips #2 -> #1 -> #2 and rows reorder with updated percentages while the VO says 'how your brand shows up in AI search, what's cited, what's not' (w39-w50). The card blurs out around 22.0s and the presenter finishes 'how answer engines actually use your content' (w51-w58) with no overlay.
shots.build_rebuild: Blur-in a white leaderboard card (blur 20px->0 with opacity 0->1 over ~0.5s), then twice FLIP-animate the five rows to new order while swapping the rank numeral and percentage values, and blur it out after ~4s.
